bio: This restaurant, where all is not what it seems, will come as something of a surprise! What, from the outside, appears to be a simple household appliance shop (you won’t find any sign whatsoever at the entrance) obscures this tiny, discreetly lit restaurant in the purest Japanese style, where the sushi bar and the chef are the undoubted stars of the show. Walter Sidoravicius, originally from Venezuela but with Lithuanian and German roots, has worked and trained around the world, most notably in Tokyo and as an instructor at the Basque Culinary Center.
